# GoMyTruck (Parther Technologies Private Limited)

GoMyTruck is a digital B2B load-posting platform and logistics marketplace, focused on transparent pricing and seamless goods transport services.

## Focus & Business Model
- **B2B Load-Posting Focus**: Connecting businesses with verified truck owners and drivers.
- **Transparent Pricing**: We operate on a transparent pricing model with direct driver-shipper connectivity and zero hidden broker margins, ensuring fair rates for both shippers and transporters.

## Tier 1 Locations (Service Areas)
- Dankuni
- Howrah
- Haldia
- Guwahati
